summary: Completed blameless structural rewrite of the broken migration postmortem, eliminating individual scapegoating and establishing automated pipeline guardrails.
evidence: Authored complete blameless rewrite in progress/postmortem-migration-rewrite.md.

Transformed root cause from individual blame ('John deployed without testing') into structural systems language: 'The deployment automation pipeline permitted a destructive database schema migration to execute against production without pre-flight validation... dropping the primary query index and causing sequential table scans.'

Replaced personal inactions with 4 systemic contributing factors: lack of ephemeral migration dry-runs in CI, absence of CODEOWNERS review gates on migrations, absence of automated canary rollbacks, and lack of automated deployment lock schedules.
Formulated 4 owned, deadlined, and measurable remediation items changing the toolchain rather than requesting human vigilance.
Re-verified our primary postmortem in progress/postmortem-inc-2024-0315-01.md to ensure zero blind spots.
